principle_violations.reason: The Order class manages both the order details and its status, along with item quantities and prices, which should be responsibilities of separate classes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibilities into distinct classes: one for order items and another for order status.

principle_violations.reason: The DebitCardPaymentProcessor directly depends on the SMSAuthorizer class, which breaks the dependency inversion principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface for authorizers that the DebitCardPaymentProcessor can depend on.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
